Cube.io · PLL two-sided identification

21 PLLs · 84 U-angle variants · 71 color-neutral UFR configurations · 284 colored non-skip states · zero ambiguous views

Author review: actual quiz answers are names only and shuffled. Candidate cube comparisons and the green correct-answer outline appear only in this audit. Candidate colors are cyclically aligned for easier comparison; no reflection or arbitrary color swapping is allowed. Lower scores mean a closer visible match.

Blocks and headlights carry the most weight, followed by equal-color relationships and adjacent/opposite color differences. The user-provided confusion families guide a third choice only where the visible geometry is close. This is a deterministic design heuristic, not a user-tested difficulty rating.
